# CW: Pharmaceuticals - WWTP Effluent

## Estimated pharmaceutical discharge

```{r setup}
library(sf)
library(utils)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(raster)
library(mapview)
library(purrr)
library(stringr) # fuzzy string matching
library(stringi)
library(janitor)
library(tibble)
```

### Watersheds and pour points

```{r}
## lets use the full state for now and then summarize by the full watersheds.
goc_ohi_rgns <- st_read(here::here("spatial/ohi_regions","goc_ohi_rgns.shp"))

union_rgns <- goc_ohi_rgns %>% 
  st_union() %>% 
  st_make_valid()

# plot(goc_ohi_rgns)
# plot(union_rgns)

watershed_all <- st_read(file.path("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/_dataprep/nutrients/watersheds_pourpoints/watersheds_all_4326.shp"))
st_crs(watershed_all)
# mapview(watershed_all)

watershed_goc <- st_intersection(st_transform(watershed_all, st_crs(union_rgns)), union_rgns)
mapview(watershed_goc)

# --- if we plan to change the buffer for some reason ---
# inland_50 <- st_read(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/inland_50km_buffer","inland_50km_goc.shp"))
# watershed_goc_50km <- st_intersection(st_transform(watershed_all, st_crs(inland_50)), inland_50)
# mapview(watershed_goc_50km)
```


```{r}
# here's the associated pourpoints that should match with the watersheds:
pourpoints <- st_read("/home/shares/ohi/stressors_2021/_dataprep/nutrients/watersheds_pourpoints/pourpoints_mol.shp")

pourpoints_goc <- st_intersection(st_transform(pourpoints, st_crs(union_rgns)), union_rgns)
mapview(pourpoints_goc)

mapview(pourpoints_goc) + mapview(watershed_goc)
```
